title: Mercy cools the body into patience
summary: Holy company cools mind and body until patience can finally settle. Let honor return to the delay.
takeaway: Let honor return to the delay.
lifeApplication: Before the complaint takes the room, let one quiet line turn waiting toward honor.

source.shortMeaning: Holy company cools mind and body until patience can finally settle.
source.lifeApplication: When agitation rises, move toward what cools you before replying.

evidence.coreClaim: Holy company cools mind and body until patience can finally settle.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: bring your searching to holy company and let it cool there.
